build_nf_resnet_model: build a Norm-Free ResNet model with a specified variant like ResNet50 for image classification
create_nf_res_block: create a Norm-Free pre-activation ResNet block with configurable bottleneck ratio and squeeze-excite support
run_nf_resnet_forward: run a forward pass through the NF_ResNet model to get logits and optional training metrics
count_nf_resnet_flops: count the FLOPs of an NF_ResNet model given input height and width dimensions
review_nf_resnet_variant_dict: review the NF_ResNet variant dictionary to compare depth patterns across ResNet50, ResNet101, ResNet152, ResNet200, ResNet288, and ResNet600
